about: #150 G5. The fingerprints of production's durable secrets, never their values. Fingerprint = first 16 hex of HMAC-SHA256(secret, 'pintar durable secret fingerprint|<name>'), made by scripts/release/durable-secrets.mjs. The production deploy refuses to replace a recorded secret and refuses a value that does not match its record. A null fingerprint means not recorded yet: the deploy prints the value's fingerprint as a warning, and it is recorded here by a commit to main. Never delete or edit a record to get a deploy past the guard: a record changes only when the secret is deliberately rotated, by a ruling, with the rotation's own procedure.
